test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What will be the simple interest on a principal of Rs. 980 for 4 years at the rate of 12 percent per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.980

Time = 4 years ; Rate = 12%

**Formula used:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (980 × 12 × 4)/100

⇒ Rs.470.4

**∴ The correct answer is 470.4.**
